Campaign

[edit]
This section needs expansion. You can help by adding missing information. (October 2026)

The Senate Leadership Fund—first reported by Semafor in October 2026—canceled a pledged $30 million in expenditures from Whatley's campaign to redirect support for Senator Roger Marshall's 2026 re-election campaign in Kansas. Since 2025, the political action committee has spent $71 million on advertisements, largely focusing on crime and public safety.[82]
